title: IM Gateway
description: Control non-secret IM trigger policy for the bundled OpenPet IM Gateway.

telegramEnabled.title: Enable Telegram
telegramEnabled.description: Enable the Telegram adapter when the IM Gateway service starts.

privateChatPolicy.title: Private chat policy
privateChatPolicy.description: Choose whether private chats require commands or can forward ordinary text to pet.say.

groupChatPolicy.title: Group chat policy
groupChatPolicy.description: Choose how group chats can trigger OpenPet.

allowedUsers.title: Allowed users
allowedUsers.description: Comma-separated Telegram user ids. Group chats always require an allowed user.

allowedChats.title: Allowed chats
allowedChats.description: Comma-separated Telegram chat ids for group or channel contexts.

allowAllPrivateChats.title: Allow all private chats
allowAllPrivateChats.description: Allow private chat triggers from any user.

allowAllGroupChats.title: Allow all group chats
allowAllGroupChats.description: Allow group chat ids without listing each chat. The sender must still be an allowed user.

petSayTtlMs.title: Speech TTL
petSayTtlMs.description: Milliseconds to show pet.say text from IM triggers.

receiptMode.title: Receipt mode
receiptMode.description: Choose when command receipts are sent back to IM.
